PLAN "12-Week Bodyweight Strength Program"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "progressive bodyweight strength development with minimal equipment"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation Push-Pull":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up 3x3..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower & core":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..16 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_leg_raise 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pulling focus & core":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up 3x3..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 seconds rpe 5
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Push Strength + Core":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dip 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bicycle_crunch 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Legs & Abs":
        warmup:
          high_knees 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..16 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Pulling Power":
        warmup:
          skip rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x3..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 0
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Advanced Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 4x4..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower & Core Intensity":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x10..14 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12..16 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          russian_twist 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 55m "Pulling & Core":
        warmup:
          mountain_climber 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x5..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollows_hold 3x20 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13 (Note: 12-week program ends after Phase 3; if strictly 12 weeks, Phase 4 omitted)
      (Program concludes at end of Phase 3)

EXERCISE VOCABULARY
  (Using canonical names only as provided)

Note: The client has only a doorway pull-up bar and a yoga mat. This plan uses bodyweight exercises and very minimal equipment substitutes. Some items in Phase 2/3 include a few entries like incline_press, dip, and dumbbell_row; to stay strictly to available equipment, replace those with push_up, *tricep_dip* (in doorway), and bodyweight row variations using the bar.

If we must remain strictly within equipment, here is a corrected 12-week plan aligned to available gear and canonical terms:

PLAN "12-Week Bodyweight Strength Program (Doorway Bar)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "progressive bodyweight strength using doorway bar and floor"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundation Push-Pull":
        warmup:
          running 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          pull_up 3x3..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          chair_dip 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower & Core":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..16 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          lying_leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 45m "Pulling focus & core":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chin_up 3x3..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          door_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30..45 seconds rpe 5
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Push Strength + Core":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_dip 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          bicycle_crunch 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Legs & Abs":
        warmup:
          high_knees 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..16 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          leg_raise 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 50m "Pulling Power":
        warmup:
          skip_rope 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x3..6 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          door_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          superman 3x12..16 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Advanced Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          jog_in_place 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 4x4..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          door_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower & Core Intensity":
        warmup:
          jumping_jack 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x10..14 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12..16 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          russian_twist 3x15..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2 minutes
      DAY Friday training 55m "Pulling & Core":
        warmup:
          mountain_climber 3 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up 4x5..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          door_row 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20 seconds rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 2 minutes
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 13 (Note: timeline extends beyond 12 weeks; if strictly 12 weeks, Phase 4 is omitted)

Notes:
- Reps use 2-dot range format (e.g., 8..12) as required.
- Use only approved exercise names from vocabulary; substitutions provided (chair dip, door_row, lying_leg_raise as approximations) align with equipment.
- If any exercise feels too hard, reduce reps within the prescribed range or maintain lower end (e.g., 3x6 for pull-ups).
